description:
One-call US property report for an address or coordinate: FEMA flood zone (SFHA, base flood elevation, FIRM panel), county demographics, and 10-year hazard history (FEMA disaster declarations, NOAA storm events, USGS earthquakes), with a plain-English summary and a source for every part.

Everything the property pack knows about one US address, in one call:
- **location**: the point used, and the state, county and census tract. - **flood**: the FEMA flood zone at the point, exactly as `flood_zone`
  returns it.
- **demographics**: county population and median household income (ACS
  5-year estimates).
- **hazards**: counts of FEMA declarations (and major disasters) and their
  types, NOAA storm events, deaths and reported damage, and USGS earthquakes within 100 km
  (since 1950), over the last ten years.

Every section has a `status`. The flood zone is required: if FEMA's map cannot be read, no report is produced and the call is not charged. Any other section that fails is marked unavailable and the report still returns. Informational screening only; see the disclaimer in the answer.

When to use: Use when the user wants an overview of a US property or address (flood risk, neighbourhood, disaster history) rather than one specific fact. One call replaces flood_zone, hazard_history and area_demographics; quote the `summary` and keep the `disclaimer`.

Billed as property.address_profile at 8c.

Every response includes a sources[] array naming the data origin and licence.
name: address_profile
title: Address Profile
